tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List LLMs tracked by Agent Cost Hub with API list prices per 1M tokens. Optional filter by provider or text.

tools.name: get_model_price
tools.description: API list price of one model (input, output, cached input per 1M tokens) plus example monthly agent costs. For retired models, rates are last recorded list prices (see pricing_basis/recorded_note).

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the monthly API cost of an AI agent or chatbot on one model. Easiest: pass model + preset (chatbot, rag, coding_agent, research_agent). Or give input_tokens, output_tokens and calls_per_day (plus optional steps_per_task, cached_percent); explicit numbers override the preset.

tools.name: compare_models
tools.description: Compare 2-5 models on price and (optionally) on the monthly cost of one workload.

tools.name: cheapest_models_for
tools.description: Rank models by monthly cost for a workload. Use a preset (chatbot, rag, coding_agent, research_agent) or give token numbers.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_model_price" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Current API list price of one model (input, output, cached input per 1M tokens) plus example monthly agent costs." → after: "API list price of one model (input, output, cached input per 1M tokens) plus example monthly agent costs. For retired models, rates are last recorded list prices (see pricing_basis/recorded_note)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
